exposure: Bilateral compression ultrasonography (CUS) of the lower limbs
finding: A strategy of routine bilateral CUS and D-dimer monitoring on the first day after cesarean section was effective in early diagnosis of VTE, including asymptomatic cases, and significantly reduced the use of LMWH prophylaxis in a Chinese Han population.
mod_finding: The overall VTE rate post-CS was 2.02% (15/742), with 66.7% (10/15) being asymptomatic.
